description: This is a PHP class file defining the Antispam model for the Opencart system. It includes a method to query the database for spam comments based on keywords.

classes.name: Antispam
classes.description: A model class responsible for detecting spam comments in the Opencart system. It provides a method to retrieve spam count based on provided comment text.

methods.name: getSpam
methods.description: Queries the database to count how many spam keywords match the provided comment text.
